blocks.content: Consistency in revision and rigorous self-assessment are the definitive keys to mastering competitive examinations.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prioritize high-weightage topics and core concepts during final preparation passes.
Maintain strict discipline in mock test analysis to minimize recurring errors.
Focus on accuracy over raw attempt count to optimize score against negative marking.
Consolidate key formulas, landmark judgments, and statutory provisions in concise notes.
Negative marking penalizes uncalculated guesses; rely on structured elimination methods.
Direct questions frequently test exact definitions, numerical figures, and key amendments.
Maintain a strict time budget per section to prevent last-minute rushing.
